items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: But after George Baquet ditched him in Philadelphia, Louis was the next best man.

ctx.x: Then they went on the road then. Then they went on the road then. Yeah.

So there's one thing about it that Louis, I don't know how he became the lady yet, but Louis wasn't much of a reader. He was a great clarinet player but he was much of a reader. He could spell a little, he would take a number home and work it out. But he was a reader that you could put a piece of music in front of his band and play his thing. And I believe that's why they choose George Baquet, because George Baquet was on the ball. But after George Baquet ditched him in Philadelphia, Louis was the next best man.
